newsitem.title: MOROCCO: British woman fined $53 for illegal sex in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: British woman fined $53 for illegal sex in Morocco.

text.p: A Moroccan court on Wednesday convicted a Moroccan student and a British woman of having illegal sex.
The man, aged 30, was give a four-month suspended jail term and fined 500 dirhams ($53.2) while the woman was fined 500 dirhams.
The pair were tried in Kenitra court, 35 km (15 miles) north of Rabat.

The woman, 44, who described herself as an "avocate" (lawyer) from the central English city of Birmingham, arrived in Moslem Morocco on June 12. She pleaded "not guilty" to illegal sex, saying in court that she was raped by the Moroccan man, described earlier as her boyfriend.
Addressing the court in English, she said: "He raped me and tried to force me to marry him. He locked me in his parents' house...I am innocent."
The man denied the court charge saying "I did not have any sexual relations with her."
Sex outside marriage is illegal under Moroccan law.
The woman appeared in court in ankle-length dark blue dress, silver necklace and her long hair done in rastafarian style. The woman is expected to return to Britain shortly.
